ORDER BY t.created_at DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE memory_turns SET project_ids = #{projectIds,typeHandler=com.superprogrammer.common.typehandler.LongArrayTypeHandler}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

UPDATE memory_turns SET tag_ids = #{tagIds,typeHandler=com.superprogrammer.common.typehandler.LongArrayTypeHandler}, l1_summary = #{l1Summary}, l2_detail = #{l2Detail}, gen_done = true, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM memory_turns t WHERE t.deleted = 0 AND t.gen_done = false AND t.born_personal = true AND t.user_id = #{userId}

SELECT d.pid AS projectId, p.name AS projectName, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM memory_turns t WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.deleted = 0 AND t.deleted_project_ids @> ARRAY[d.pid]::bigint[]) AS turnCount FROM (SELECT DISTINCT unnest(t.deleted_project_ids) AS pid FROM memory_turns t WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.deleted = 0) d LEFT JOIN projects p ON p.id = d.pid ORDER BY d.pid ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM memory_turns t WHERE t.user_id = #{userId} AND t.deleted = 0 AND t.deleted_project_ids @> ARRAY[#{projectId}]::bigint[]
mapper.update: UPDATE memory_turns SET project_ids = array_append(project_ids, #{newProjectId}), updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND project_ids @> ARRAY[#{fromProjectId}]::bigint[] AND NOT (project_ids @> ARRAY[#{newProjectId}]::bigint[])

UPDATE memory_turns SET project_ids = CASE WHEN project_ids @> ARRAY[#{newProjectId}]::bigint[] THEN project_ids ELSE array_append(project_ids, #{newProjectId}) END, deleted_project_ids = array_remove(deleted_project_ids, #{deletedProjectId}), updated_at = NOW() WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND deleted = 0 AND deleted_project_ids @> ARRAY[#{deletedProjectId}]::bigint[]
